description: Installation of new ATM with advert logo
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-3a2787a8-7fff-23eb-82e6-86a630cd1758"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal, by reason of its design, siting, size, and location on the locally listed building, would fail to </span><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 14.6667px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">conserve or enhance and reveal the significance of the non-designated asset and its setting. Furthermore, the propsoal would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Dalston Conservation Area, harming </span></font><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">the visual amenities of the area. </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">As such, the proposal is contrary to policies, LP1, LP3, LP4, and LP7 of Hackney's Local Plan (2020) and policies D3, D4, and HC1 of the London Plan (2021).</span></p>
